inputs.name: postgres_version
inputs.description: PostgreSQL major version to install, from 14 to 18.

inputs.name: listen_addresses
inputs.description: Addresses PostgreSQL listens on, comma-separated, such as "localhost", "*" or "127.0.0.1,10.0.0.5". Changing it restarts PostgreSQL.

inputs.name: settings
inputs.description: postgresql.conf settings, such as { shared_buffers = "256MB", max_connections = "200" }. They go to conf.d/conn3x.conf, and changing them restarts PostgreSQL.

inputs.name: hba
inputs.type:
list(object({
    type     = string
    database = string
    user     = string
    address  = optional(string)
    method   = string
  }))
inputs.description: pg_hba.conf rules, in order. A rule letting postgres in over the local socket with peer always comes first. Changing them reloads PostgreSQL.

inputs.name: users
inputs.description: Roles to create with LOGIN. Each needs a password in user_passwords.

inputs.name: user_passwords
inputs.description: Password for each of users, by name. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_user_passwords; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: databases
inputs.description: Databases to create, each mapped to its owner, such as { app = "app" }. The owner must be one of users or an existing role.
